case_number: 2025 INSC 92; PETITION FOR SPECIAL LEAVE TO APPEAL(C) NO. 30442/2019
summary: Maintainability of suit by partner of unregistered firm; Section 69, Indian Partnership Act, 1932 – mandatory bar; suit to enforce contractual rights invalid unless firm registered; exception for dissolution and accounts under Section 69(3); reliance on Seth Loonkaran Sethiya and Mukund Balkrishna Kulkarni; High Court correct in holding suit non-maintainable; no concession for non-commencement of business; Bishen Narain cited; impugned decision upheld.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; impugned High Court order upholding non-maintainability of suit sustained.
